policy.identity: Exact original 2024–25 NCES LEA 1301290 / CCD GA-633 / EDC 633 ownership. Join authoritative twelve-digit NCES IDs and cross-check exact GA-633-#### / 633-#### source fields. Names, corrected digits, padding, county labels and other charter LEAs never establish ownership.
policy.population: Operational exact CCD profiles require complete unadjusted reported grade offers, highest grade 01–08, an offered grade 3–8, no offered grades 9–13/adult, positive own reported membership reconciled to all reported PK–8 subtotals, positive reported enrolled grades 3–8, and only explicit zero outside PK–8. If ungraded is offered, its own subtotal must be explicitly Reported zero. High, mixed, primary, unknown, adjusted, zero or unjoined profiles remain outside; no planning count approves membership.
policy.income: Own reported CCD Final 2a Direct Certification Education Unit Total divided by own positive reported same-year Membership Education Unit Total. Preserve the individual benefits/status proxy, including pre-K where enrolled. This is not full household-income FRPL or universal/CEP meal receipt. Both counts require Reported flags; no derived count, funding/claiming multiplier, FRPL fallback, tested subgroup or other-year backfill is used.
policy.income_metadata: Original Georgia CCD-0060 says Medicaid income was added to SNAP/TANF certification starting 2024 and foster records were received. Georgia membership covers state-funded programs and includes prekindergarten pupils in outside programs. Neither definition establishes the exact tested G38 population or completeness of direct certification; reporting coverage and undercount remain unknown.
policy.assessment: Only exact original EDC v3.1 SEA-sourced Georgia Milestones EOG regular School/All Students/All Students native G38 grades 3–8, Levels 3–4 published ProficientOrAbove_percent supports prospective rates. Use the direct original 0–1 token; never average grades, substitute count ratios, splice alternate assessments or pool subgroup/district rows. Native EOG totals do not establish accelerated pupils or EOC course coverage; that population treatment remains uncertified from the retained definitions. Original assessment-name/cut-score flags remain evidence; no EOC/alternate splice or incompatible history is created.
policy.counts: EDC tested, proficient and level counts remain raw unverified evidence and may be constructed from native displays. All valid-score denominators, variances and interval endpoints remain null; the ten-valid-scored floor is uncertified. Enrollment, direct certification, participation and federal 95% measures never substitute. Existing source holds remain without repeated failed investigations.
policy.attribution: Retain all original Georgia notes, exact named identities and later-release program gaps. No current Cobb-specific attribution warning is inferred from unrelated districts, and absence of a named note does not certify attribution completeness. School/district enrollment differences, if present, do not establish a cause.
policy.suppression: Explicit zero, suppressed/ranged, missing, nonreported and derived values remain distinct. No midpoint, complement or another-year backfill. Native-only identities remain unjoined without inferred school ownership or income.
policy.combined: Equal mean of exact usable original Math and ELA rates with own same-year individual income; not proficiency in both. A future Combined model needs its own fit, scale and studentization; this audit creates no models.
policy.limitations: Original charter, alternative/type, virtual and grade disagreement evidence is retained without admissions, provider, geometry, causal effectiveness or school-quality inference. Original Georgia EDC business-rule and tested-population limits remain explicit.
policy.eligibility: Reconstruct exact same-year operational NCES/native ownership, complete lower grade offerings and positive reconciled own reported enrolled grades 3–8, individual reported direct certification / own reported membership, and original regular Georgia Milestones EOG School All Students G38 Math/ELA published-rate tokens. Retain all 90 grade-school profiles; primary-only, high and mixed scopes stay outside. No charter, income extreme, diagnostics, unverified count, grade average or old statewide result selects inputs.
policy.models: Separate unweighted centered Cobb County 2024–25 grade-school Math, ELA and Combined OLS. Combined independently fits paired original-rate means with its own scale, explicit deleted fits and external studentization, never averaged studentized scores. No enrollment weights, shrinkage, causal-effect claims, fit-driven exclusions, clamping or national pooling.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use every explicit deleted-school fit with N−3 residual degrees of freedom, independent centered full fits and held-out leverage. Cook distance and prediction sensitivity over observed income are descriptive, never eligibility filters.
policy.intervals: All valid-score counts, sampling variances and endpoints are null modelwide; the ten-valid-scored floor remains uncertified. A zero variance vector supplied to the shared fitter is solely a point-estimate computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.
policy.compact_provenance: The complete immutable linked source retains 2,260 needed original records / 68,573 typed cells, full schemas and primary definitions, plus exact omission inventories for 25,662 complete target records / 865,003 cells. Whole source blob/code/tests, original raw/schema/definition/identity and current literal source/numerical policy/runtime checks are required before every replay, including supplied expected fits. Compact exact inputs and table/member/row/header-field references replace duplicated raw evidence. Supplied expected values must match freshly rebuilt source-derived full/deleted fits and cannot authorize themselves.
policy.release: Numerical audit only pending independent review and separate canonical/browser integration. Historical source and numerical approvals remain false. Georgia Medicaid/foster direct-certification scope, outside-program prekindergarten membership, nonlisted attribution coverage, accelerated EOG/EOC population uncertainty, masks and count limitations remain explicit.

ga_all_students_crosscheck.role: Reproducible whole-state School/All Students/All Students Math/ELA original-record subset; exact original CSV cross-check, not a source of fitted results

retained_source_reference.note: Complete needed original records, schemas, primary definitions and exact omitted-population/identity/row inventories stay in the immutable linked source. Every numerical replay requires the current unchanged complete source/code/tests and literal policy/runtime semantic validation.

count_definition_status.reason: Original EDC tested/level counts may be constructed and remain uncertified valid-score denominators. Own CCD membership/direct certification never substitutes, filters models or certifies a scored-count floor.
